title: Project inspection rubric (9 questions)
what_it_does: Reading order for a project (index.html, CSS variables, README, user flow) and nine questions to answer before planning: what it is, best claim, visual hook, what UI to show, shortest satisfying length, tone.
when_to_use: In the launch setup interview, before any storyboard is written, so the video is about the product in use and not about its marketing page.
why: Good discipline (entry, key action, result beats) and permissive. Trim web-project assumptions for people who only have an app or a screen recording.
